text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf delivered brilliant results 
in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

It was one day while basking alone in the 
afterglow of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer-kun, deep in thought as you may 
be, it is nearly time for your interview.”
choice_data_list:
Huh, how long have you been standing 
there?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just a moment ago. I wanted to call out to 
you right away, but you seemed to be 
staring off into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If it's a matter of great importance, I 
have a little more time to wait."
choice_data_list:
I was just looking back on these past 
three years.

I was just looking back on these past 
three years.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see. So that's why...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Time flies like an arrow. Looking back, 
those three years passed in the blink of 
an eye.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, it's too early to look back now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As evidenced by the press being here, all 
eyes are still fixed on us with great 
intensity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will need you to keep accompanying me on 
my dream for a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, good answer. That's what I was 
waiting to hear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then— shall we continue walking 
together into the future?
